tools.name: create_game
tools.description: Set up any game to play in this chat: board games, card games, dice games, word and guessing games, mysteries. Describe it with the building blocks below, or pass starter for a ready one (tic-tac-toe, four-in-a-row, gomoku, checkers, reversi, crazy-eights, go-fish, twenty-one, pig, sea-battle, hangm

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: What your seat can see now: the board, your hand, public piles, scores, dice, secrets you hold and the recent log. Call it when the player says they've moved or it might be your turn.

tools.name: take_turn
tools.description:
Apply one or more actions for your seat, all or nothing: if any action is illegal, none happen and you get the reason. Usually end with end_turn. Action types and fields:
- place {at: "B3"} or {column: "D"} with gravity; optional label, shape (disc, square, ring, star, diamond), color, kind, owner
-

tools.name: show_board
tools.description: Show the interactive board in the chat again, for example after a long conversation or when the player asks to see it.
